score: 0-10 = 0.7 x mean judgement (timing, framing, move, acting, props/graphics, look, join) + 0.3 x measured (0.5 aligned motion-energy correlation + 0.5 x min(1, SSIM/0.5)); SSIM on blurred luma at 180x320 with the caption band masked; dE = mean Lab difference of 8 px blocks

shot3_fix.what: owner feedback: theirs orbits, starts wider, pushes to one dragon, tilts down to the frog; the jar reads pale grey-white with bright gold dragons. Rebuilt in exact mode: an orbit of 46 deg F223-F300 (az -48 -> -2) with a dolly from F260, a push F300-F345, a lens push to dragon 1 F345-F362 and a lens tilt to its frog F362-F404 from one spot; jar #e2eaf8, dragons 0.72 scale. Only F225-F404 re-rendered (renders/ours_v11_shot3.mp4 = v10 with the new span spliced in).
shot3_fix.status: orbit and zoom now match (tx -3.9/-2.7 vs -2.4/-3.1 px/f on F225-F300; zoom 0.60 vs 0.59 %/f on F260-F300; tx 0.29 vs 0.46 on F300-F345; per-frame tx corr 0.15 -> 0.71, zoom 0.34 -> 0.73). Not fixed: the push and tilt land in the wrong phase (ours moves the content up 200 px on F345-F362, theirs 64 px down, then theirs tilts down 460 px on F362-F404 and ours barely moves: our F362 framing is too wide, so the frog is already in frame), so overall motion-energy correlation fell (compare.py 0.15 -> -0.01). F229-F231 open on a column the orbit's start passes through. Fix for the next pass: start at az -38, frame the dragon at F362 tight enough that the frog is out of frame, then tilt down to it. Stopped at the 3-iteration limit (a 4th render replaced a lighting regression in iteration 3).

technique_1_depth_plate.how: Depth Anything V2 small (official weights, MPS) -> metric depth 1.1-26 m -> 180x320 camera-space grid textured from the key camera (kit/plate.ts); our live inventor card stands on the painted one; the push is a lens push (zoom 40 -> 14.5 deg) with a 0.12 m dolly
technique_1_depth_plate.usable_range: push <= ~0.1 m (2.9 % stretched), orbit <= ~1 deg (7.6 %), truck <= ~5 cm (6.3 %), tilt <= ~1 deg (plate edge: 97.6 % covered), zoom unlimited by stretch but resolution-limited (941 px key frame: 2.5x zoom = 2.9x upscale at 1080 wide)

hook_match.note: the trial covers the push F0-F58 and holds; the crane F59-F91 is outside the plate

technique_2_sdf_dragon.how: scripts/sdf_dragon.py: SDF primitives (cranium, snout, nose pad, lips, brows, cheeks, open jaw, mouth cavity, segmented horns, mane and beard blades, crest, S-neck), smooth unions, marching cubes (step 14 mm, 83k triangles), scale normal map, gold, ink; teeth, eyes, whiskers, ball as kit parts at exported anchors (kit/codemodels.ts)
technique_2_sdf_dragon.camera_range: full 3D: any move (the shot-3 orbit of ~45 deg, the push and tilt)
